Timeline: The evidence vault behind this site is opened; the first capture of the BBC live page is at 08:04:53Z.
Timeline: The UK NCSC page is modified (HTTP last-modified).
Timeline: Ryan Austin on BBC Radio 4: no evidence of exploitation yet.
Timeline: The BBC reports the NSA's X post.
Timeline: Greenbone on oss-security: the backports imply versions down to 7.4 are affected, whatever the subject line says.
Timeline: BBC News opens its live page: 'Global scramble to fix critical cyber-security flaws as many websites taken offline'.
Timeline: JVN publishes its note (14:20 JST); JPCERT/CC alert JPCERT-AT-2026-0033 is dated 22 October.
Timeline: Matthew Prince posts Cloudflare's attempt counts: thousands before, millions after.
Timeline: NSA Cybersecurity posts 'UPDATE: Specific mitigation guidance ... is now available', linking the press release.
